description: Detector class name -> catalogue SKU. Lets a stock COCO-pretrained YOLOv8n drive the full pipeline before an India-specific SKU detector is trained. Once the detector is fine-tuned on real Indian retail classes, Product.detection_class_name takes over and this file shrinks to the leftovers.
notes: Keys are matched case-insensitively. A class with no entry is still detected — it reports as an EXTRA (off-planogram) object rather than being silently dropped. COCO has no Indian-brand classes, so generic shapes stand in: a Bisleri bottle is a 'bottle', an Amul pouch is closest to 'vase'.
